answer: The design leans on redundant verification across independent nodes. Written in a concise reports, one example per claim register, it stays short. A summit of per-task receipts records who did what, and the horizon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the pulse of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
